package main

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"

	nethtml "golang.org/x/net/html"
)

func TestAppkitFleetFreshnessDisplayQuality(t *testing.T) {
	base := syntheticModel()
	if len(base.Services) == 0 {
		t.Fatal("syntheticModel must provide a service row")
	}
	service := func(name, freshness string) obsServiceRow {
		row := base.Services[0]
		row.Service = name
		row.Freshness = freshness
		return row
	}

	tests := []struct {
		name       string
		services   []obsServiceRow
		degraded   string
		wantValue  string
		wantReason []string
		wantRole   string
		refuseText []string
	}{
		{
			name:      "complete known freshness is positive",
			services:  []obsServiceRow{service("alpha", "fresh"), service("beta", "fresh")},
			wantValue: "all fresh",
			wantRole:  "text-positive",
		},
		{
			name:       "known stale count is exact",
			services:   []obsServiceRow{service("alpha", "fresh"), service("beta", "stale: indexed a vs HEAD b")},
			wantValue:  "1 stale repo",
			wantRole:   "text-caution",
			refuseText: []string{"all fresh", "≥"},
		},
		{
			name:       "pathless unknown is absent",
			services:   []obsServiceRow{service("alpha", "unknown: no recorded corpus path")},
			wantValue:  "—",
			wantReason: []string{"0 of 1", "unknown", "no recorded corpus path"},
			wantRole:   "text-ink-faint",
			refuseText: []string{"all fresh"},
		},
		{
			name:       "blank freshness is unavailable",
			services:   []obsServiceRow{service("alpha", "")},
			wantValue:  "—",
			wantReason: []string{"0 of 1"},
			wantRole:   "text-ink-faint",
			refuseText: []string{"all fresh"},
		},
		{
			name:       "empty fleet is absent",
			wantValue:  "—",
			wantReason: []string{"no", "service"},
			wantRole:   "text-ink-faint",
			refuseText: []string{"all fresh"},
		},
		{
			name:       "unexpected freshness is unavailable",
			services:   []obsServiceRow{service("alpha", "surprising future state")},
			wantValue:  "—",
			wantReason: []string{"0 of 1", "surprising future state"},
			wantRole:   "text-ink-faint",
			refuseText: []string{"all fresh"},
		},
		{
			name:       "stale-like unexpected token is unavailable",
			services:   []obsServiceRow{service("alpha", "staleness? index state unavailable")},
			wantValue:  "—",
			wantReason: []string{"0 of 1", "staleness? index state unavailable"},
			wantRole:   "text-ink-faint",
			refuseText: []string{"all fresh", "stale repo"},
		},
		{
			name:       "fresh plus unknown cannot claim all fresh",
			services:   []obsServiceRow{service("alpha", "fresh"), service("beta", "unknown: no recorded corpus path")},
			wantValue:  "—",
			wantReason: []string{"1 of 2", "unknown", "no recorded corpus path"},
			wantRole:   "text-ink-faint",
			refuseText: []string{"all fresh"},
		},
		{
			name:       "stale plus unknown is a named lower bound",
			services:   []obsServiceRow{service("alpha", "stale: indexed a vs HEAD b"), service("beta", "unknown: no recorded corpus path")},
			wantValue:  "≥ 1 stale repo",
			wantReason: []string{"1 of 2", "unknown", "no recorded corpus path"},
			wantRole:   "text-caution",
			refuseText: []string{"all fresh"},
		},
		{
			name: "multiple stale plus unknown keeps the lower-bound count",
			services: []obsServiceRow{
				service("alpha", "stale: indexed a vs HEAD b"),
				service("beta", "stale: indexed c vs HEAD d"),
				service("gamma", "unknown: statusz unreachable"),
			},
			wantValue:  "≥ 2 stale repos",
			wantReason: []string{"2 of 3", "unknown", "statusz unreachable"},
			wantRole:   "text-caution",
			refuseText: []string{"all fresh"},
		},
		{
			name:       "registry degradation overrides poisoned populated rows",
			services:   []obsServiceRow{service("alpha", "fresh"), service("beta", "stale: indexed a vs HEAD b")},
			degraded:   "registry unavailable: synthetic refusal",
			wantValue:  "—",
			wantReason: []string{"registry unavailable", "synthetic refusal"},
			wantRole:   "text-ink-faint",
			refuseText: []string{"all fresh", "stale repo"},
		},
		{
			name:       "registry degradation with an empty fleet is absent",
			degraded:   "registry unavailable: empty synthetic refusal",
			wantValue:  "—",
			wantReason: []string{"registry unavailable", "empty synthetic refusal"},
			wantRole:   "text-ink-faint",
			refuseText: []string{"all fresh", "stale repo"},
		},
		{
			name:       "registry degradation invalidates otherwise fresh rows",
			services:   []obsServiceRow{service("alpha", "fresh"), service("beta", "fresh")},
			degraded:   "registry unavailable: fresh rows are untrusted",
			wantValue:  "—",
			wantReason: []string{"registry unavailable", "fresh rows are untrusted"},
			wantRole:   "text-ink-faint",
			refuseText: []string{"all fresh", "stale repo"},
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			model := base
			model.Services = tt.services
			model.DegradedNote = tt.degraded
			value, reason, classes := appkitDisplayFreshnessTile(t, renderObsFleet(model))
			if value != tt.wantValue {
				t.Errorf("index freshness value = %q, want %q", value, tt.wantValue)
			}
			combined := strings.ToLower(value + " " + reason)
			for _, want := range tt.wantReason {
				if !strings.Contains(combined, strings.ToLower(want)) {
					t.Errorf("index freshness value/reason %q does not name %q", combined, want)
				}
			}
			if tt.wantRole != "" && !strings.Contains(classes, tt.wantRole) {
				t.Errorf("index freshness classes = %q, want role %q", classes, tt.wantRole)
			}
			for _, refuse := range tt.refuseText {
				if strings.Contains(combined, strings.ToLower(refuse)) {
					t.Errorf("index freshness must refuse %q, got %q", refuse, combined)
				}
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestAppkitKVLongDiagnosticWraps(t *testing.T) {
	const label = `<freshness & source>`
	diagnostic := `<unreadable & path> ` + strings.Repeat("segment/", 96)
	got := kv(label, absentCell(diagnostic))

	doc, err := nethtml.Parse(strings.NewReader(got))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	row := appkitDisplayFirstElement(doc, "div")
	if row == nil || !appkitDisplayHasClass(row, "min-w-0") {
		t.Fatalf("kv row must be shrinkable: %q", got)
	}
	var children []*nethtml.Node
	for child := row.FirstChild; child != nil; child = child.NextSibling {
		if child.Type == nethtml.ElementNode && child.Data == "span" {
			children = append(children, child)
		}
	}
	if len(children) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("kv direct span children = %d, want 2: %q", len(children), got)
	}
	value := children[1]
	prose := appkitDisplayFirstElement(value.FirstChild, "span")
	if prose == nil || !appkitDisplayHasClass(prose, "block") || !appkitDisplayHasClass(prose, "text-left") {
		t.Error("unavailable-source prose must retain a left reading edge inside the value column")
	}
	for _, class := range []string{"min-w-0", "text-right", "[overflow-wrap:anywhere]"} {
		if !appkitDisplayHasClass(value, class) {
			t.Errorf("kv value classes must include %q: %q", class, appkitDisplayAttr(value, "class"))
		}
	}
	if appkitDisplayText(children[0]) != label || appkitDisplayText(value) != diagnostic {
		t.Errorf("kv must preserve escaped label/diagnostic text: label=%q value=%q", appkitDisplayText(children[0]), appkitDisplayText(value))
	}
	if strings.Contains(got, label) || strings.Contains(got, diagnostic) {
		t.Error("kv output contains hostile text without HTML escaping")
	}
}

func appkitDisplayFreshnessTile(t *testing.T, body string) (value, reason, classes string) {
	t.Helper()
	doc, err := nethtml.Parse(strings.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var walk func(*nethtml.Node)
	walk = func(n *nethtml.Node) {
		if value != "" || n == nil {
			return
		}
		if n.Type == nethtml.ElementNode && n.Data == "dl" && appkitDisplayAttr(n, "aria-label") == "fleet evidence status" {
			for cell := n.FirstChild; cell != nil; cell = cell.NextSibling {
				var dt, dd *nethtml.Node
				for child := cell.FirstChild; child != nil; child = child.NextSibling {
					if child.Type != nethtml.ElementNode {
						continue
					}
					switch child.Data {
					case "dt":
						dt = child
					case "dd":
						dd = child
					}
				}
				if dt == nil || dd == nil || strings.TrimSpace(appkitDisplayText(dt)) != "index freshness" {
					continue
				}
				var inspect func(*nethtml.Node)
				inspect = func(node *nethtml.Node) {
					if node.Type == nethtml.ElementNode {
						classes += " " + appkitDisplayAttr(node, "class")
						if node.Data == "span" && appkitDisplayHasClass(node, "text-2xl") {
							value = strings.TrimSpace(appkitDisplayText(node))
						}
						if node.Data == "span" && appkitDisplayHasClass(node, "text-sm") && appkitDisplayHasClass(node, "font-medium") && appkitDisplayHasClass(node, "text-ink-muted") {
							reason = strings.TrimSpace(appkitDisplayText(node))
						}
					}
					for child := node.FirstChild; child != nil; child = child.NextSibling {
						inspect(child)
					}
				}
				inspect(dd)
				return
			}
		}
		for child := n.FirstChild; child != nil; child = child.NextSibling {
			walk(child)
		}
	}
	walk(doc)
	if value == "" {
		t.Fatal("fleet evidence status index-freshness dt/dd not found")
	}
	return value, reason, classes
}

func appkitDisplayFirstElement(n *nethtml.Node, name string) *nethtml.Node {
	if n == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if n.Type == nethtml.ElementNode && n.Data == name {
		return n
	}
	for child := n.FirstChild; child != nil; child = child.NextSibling {
		if found := appkitDisplayFirstElement(child, name); found != nil {
			return found
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func appkitDisplayAttr(n *nethtml.Node, key string) string {
	for _, a := range n.Attr {
		if a.Key == key {
			return a.Val
		}
	}
	return ""
}

func appkitDisplayHasClass(n *nethtml.Node, want string) bool {
	for _, class := range strings.Fields(appkitDisplayAttr(n, "class")) {
		if class == want {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func appkitDisplayText(n *nethtml.Node) string {
	if n == nil {
		return ""
	}
	if n.Type == nethtml.TextNode {
		return n.Data
	}
	var b strings.Builder
	for child := n.FirstChild; child != nil; child = child.NextSibling {
		b.WriteString(appkitDisplayText(child))
	}
	return b.String()
}
